prompts.text: Erklaere in drei kurzen Absaetzen, warum ein Mixture-of-Experts-Modell auf einer einzelnen Consumer-Grafikkarte langsamer sein kann als ein dichtes Modell aequaler Qualitaet. Nenne zwei konkrete Engpaesse.
In three short paragraphs, explain why a mixture-of-experts model on a single consumer GPU can be slower than a dense model of equal quality. Name two concrete bottlenecks.

Write a complete Python 3.11 module `cache.py`: an async TTL cache with `get`, `set`, `delete`, `clear`, thread-safe locking, type hints, docstrings, and six unittest test cases. Output only the code, no prose.

A train leaves A at 09:00 at 60 km/h. A second leaves B at 09:30 at 80 km/h toward A. The distance AB is 350 km. At what time and where do they meet? Show the equations, then give the final answer in one sentence.
Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown: an object with keys 'name' (string), 'n' (integer, 42), 'items' (array of three strings), and 'ok' (boolean true).

You have a tool `get_weather(city: str)`. The user asks: 'What is the weather in Berlin?' Reply with a single tool call to get_weather with the correct argument. Do not answer the weather question yourself.
